verdict.rationale: Cline documents human-in-the-loop approval for tool calls, configurable auto-approve settings (including an all-or-nothing 'YOLO mode'), and MCP as the mechanism for external tool/data access, which together let a user control what integrations run — but this is per-user/session control, not documented org-wide policy enforcement, allowlisting, or admin-level restriction of specific MCP servers/integrations for an engineering-lead role. Missing for 10: team/org-level policy or allowlist controls, audit logging of tool access, and evidence of centralized admin governance over integrations.
